visual_description: A thick, heavy-duty laptop with a magnesium alloy chassis and reinforced rubber corners. The screen is high-brightness 'sunlight-readable' matte finish. It is shown open, displaying a 3D wireframe model of a dinosaur bone. It has a built-in handle and port covers to keep out dust and moisture.

constraints.material: Textured black and silver metal; glowing backlit keyboard (amber or red for night work).
constraints.logic: The primary interface for all 'High-Tech' tools like GPR and LIDAR scanners.
